sentences.text: The product note says that for individual borrowers on floating-rate loans for non-business purposes, no foreclosure charge applies.

The only other in-force bank document provided that states a foreclosure charge on loan pre-payment is a home loan agreement that says a 2% charge applies, but it is a different document from the product note.
I cannot confirm that the Retail Loan Policy agrees with the product note because no Retail Loan Policy text was provided in the evidence searched.

The RBI directions in force in the evidence also say that, for loans to individuals for purposes other than business, an RE shall not levy pre-payment charges, but applicability to this case was not resolved in the rule findings.

missing.slot: Retail Loan Policy text on foreclosure/pre-payment charges
missing.searched: Reviewed the provided evidence set for a Retail Loan Policy document and found only the product note and home loan agreement documents; no Retail Loan Policy text was present.
